title: Short: IFL: Real Kashmir to face Nagaland United in season opener at Srinagar
text:
Short: IFL: Real Kashmir to face Nagaland United in season opener at Srinagar IFL: Real Kashmir to face Nagaland United in season opener at Srinagar
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 Real Kashmir Football Club (RKFC) will face Nagaland United FC in the opening match of the Indian Football League (IFL) 2026-27 season on October 30 at TRC Ground, Srinagar
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 The match, scheduled to start at 6:30 pm., will be played under floodlights, with support from the J&K; Sports Council and local authorities.
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 RKFC, previously part of the I-League, features a diverse squad of local, national, and international players, coached by Ishfaq Ahmad
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 Ishfaq Ahmad praised Nagaland United FC as a formidable opponent, despite it being their first IFL appearance, and expressed readiness for the challenge
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 Club owner Arshad Nizam Shawl emphasized RKFC's mission to create opportunities for Kashmiri youth and showcase local talent through football
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 Shawl highlighted the club's broader vision of presenting Kashmir as a symbol of hope, resilience, and aspiration through sports
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 Gratitude was extended to the J&K; Sports Council and officials like Tazayun Mukhtar and Sarmad Hafeez for their support in promoting football in the region
 Powered by
 Read Full Story 
 RKFC is the sole representative from Jammu and Kashmir in the IFL, providing a platform for local footballers to shine

 The club encouraged local football fans to attend the match in large numbers to support the home team in its season opener
